genesis.description: CID of the document's first Change, which is its identity; omitted on the genesis Change itself.

deps.description: CIDs of the head Changes the author built on, sorted by CID; omitted on the genesis Change.

depth.description: One more than the deepest dependency's depth; omitted on the genesis Change.

body.description: The operations this Change applies to the document's content and metadata.

description: A signed delta on a document that links the Changes it depends on and carries the operations that edit its content and metadata.
